description: Internet Marketing Fundamentals 1-Day Workshop - Grand Prairie, TX Dive into the basics of internet marketing and level up your skills in this fun, one-day hands-on training session! Event Details Duration: 1-Day Practical Training (8 Hours) Timing: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (including breaks) Location: Location shared via email ( Complete Address ) Format: Classroom Training (Virtual option available on request) Language: English Certificate: Course Completion Certificate PDUs Awarded: 8 Professional Development Units Contact: info@learnerring.com Event Description In today’s digital-first world, businesses must understand how to market effectively online to stay competitive. This one-day Internet Marketing Fundamentals Workshop gives participants the essential skills to build a strong online presence, attract the right audience, and convert leads into customers. From understanding your brand’s strengths using a structured SWOT framework to leveraging SEO, social media, web content, online campaigns, and lead generation tactics—this workshop covers the core pillars of modern digital marketing. Designed for beginners, business owners, marketers, freelancers, and anyone wanting to grow online, this training blends strategy with action-oriented tools you can start using immediately. By the end of the session, you’ll know how to create impactful content, design optimized web pages, run engaging campaigns, and build a consistent digital brand. This course is highly relevant for anyone looking to improve online visibility, increase website traffic, and strengthen digital communication skills.
